title: NOVOO 67W GaN Charger White $15.39 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Mbest-AU via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: NOVOO 67W GaN Charger White $15.39 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Mbest-AU via Amazon AU

[jazzpdp] Looked like a listing issue while in the middle of applying the promo that got fixed now xD
[Wilburre] Unobtainable deal - only the full price black version is eligible for the spend $2 get 30% off.
The price for the white version also got jacked from $25 to $35.
Shame as I have this charger and have no complaints with it. Does what it says it will and doesn't heat up much.
Have used it with Switch, phones, laptop, surface laptop from work.
A steal if you can pick it up under $20.
There is also a SKU that comes with a type C cable and while nothing special they are good for 65w charging. Not sure if the cables can do more.
[jmc787] Black one with a cable is $27.99, not bad
[razorback] Ordered white one for $21.99
Regularly on sale for this price
[davidl222222] cheapest was around $19.99, $15.39 is the lowest!
[AustriaBargain] My mother has a tonne of chargers with this rough design around her house, I don't know where she's getting them from.
